  <div class="academic-profile-grid">
    <div class="profile-copy">
      <p>I am an Assistant Professor at <a href="https://www.telecom-sudparis.eu/">Télécom SudParis</a>, <a href="https://www.ip-paris.fr/en">Institut Polytechnique de Paris</a>. I joined Télécom SudParis in February 2026 after a postdoctoral position in the Multimedia team at Télécom Paris, where I worked with Jhony H. Giraldo and Fragkiskos D. Malliaros.</p>
      <p>My research lies at the intersection of <strong>graph machine learning</strong>, <strong>graph signal processing</strong>, and <strong>graph neural networks</strong>. I develop theoretically grounded methods for multi-domain and higher-order relational structures, with applications including biomedical data and brain signals, weather, traffic forecasting, and emerging generative-model settings.</p>
      <p>I received my PhD in Electrical Engineering from Sharif University of Technology in 2023. My doctoral research focused on subspace identification and graph learning of graph signals, especially for brain-signal processing. My recent work extends these ideas to simplicial complexes, hypergraphs, and continuous graph-learning models.</p>
